name: MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) - 19th Anniversary Edition, Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu Super AoLong AI 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core) - 19th Anniversary Edition is a rechargeable smart cube built on an 8-magnet Ball-Core that captures your solves in 360 degrees while you turn. WCU CUBE smart gameplay pairs with the cube over Bluetooth so you can review your technique move by move, and the MagLev core with 8-level digital tuning lets you dial in exactly the feel you want.
features: Rechargeable, no batteries to swap: Roughly 30 hours of battery life and a charging case included in the box.
Tune it to you, not the other way around: 8-level tension, 8-level elasticity, and 8-level corner magnetic adjustment let you set the feel by hand.
Anniversary-edition presentation: Ships in the Super AoLong 19th Anniversary collector's gift box with a full accessory set.
One-button dual adjustment: A single control moves multiple magnetic forces at once so you can adapt the cube to different finger-tricks quickly.
8-level tension: Clear, numbered steps for balancing tightness and looseness without guesswork.
8-level corner magnetic adjustment: Dial the edge-and-corner pull up or down for faster magnetic alignment.
